skill.name: analysis-tree
skill.description: Maintains a structured analysis tree that connects data questions, evidence, conclusions, pruned branches, and the current investigation position.
skill.summary: Track evolving data analysis reasoning in one structured Markdown document.
skill.author: crystal-cat2

security_audit.summary: All eight static findings are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, Chinese prose, and a broad entropy heuristic. The skill maintains local Markdown analysis state and does not execute commands, perform reconnaissance, or conceal executable content.

static_findings.snippet: - 非数据分析场景仅在用户明确要求使用 `analysis-tree` 或“分析树”时使用。
状态使用 `待验证`、`已结论` 或 `已剪枝`。具体数值、SQL、工具调用和执行日志保留在原始材料中;树只保留理解问题依赖所需的简要证据。当前结论保持证据能够支持的强度。仅当重大重构会影响读者理解时
用户要求查看时,根据最新状态文档即时生成 Mermaid 流程图:节点显示编号、问题、状态和可压缩的一行结论;高亮当前位置,弱化已剪枝节点,保留完整连接关系。详细证据继续保留在 Markdown 正文

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 14 uses Markdown inline code to name the analysis-tree skill. It contains no Ruby expression, shell command, or execution instruction.
Line 21 formats a local Markdown document path as inline code. The path is documentation for state storage and is not a command.
Lines 52 through 74 are a fenced Markdown template for the analysis tree document. The fence contains headings and placeholders, not executable shell or Ruby content.
Lines 74 and 75 show an inline node identifier and close the surrounding Markdown example. Neither construct invokes an external command.
Lines 75 through 77 close a Markdown fence and describe allowed Chinese status labels. No executable command or interpolation is present.
Line 77 uses inline code formatting for three status values. It explicitly keeps tool calls and execution logs in source materials rather than executing anything.
Line 85 describes generating a Mermaid diagram from the skill's own state document when requested. It does not inspect system configuration, accounts, processes, or network state.

SKILL.md is readable Chinese Markdown with YAML metadata and a visible document template. Its multilingual character distribution explains the entropy score, with no encoded or encrypted payload present.

content.value_statement: Complex data investigations lose context when questions, evidence, and conclusions remain scattered. This skill maintains them in one evolving analysis tree.
actual_capabilities: Maintains one Markdown state document for each analysis question.
Connects questions, hypotheses, evidence, conclusions, and branch status.
Adds, rewrites, reorganizes, or prunes nodes as understanding changes.
Marks the current analysis position and updates affected parent conclusions.
Generates a Mermaid flowchart from the latest state when requested.
Prepares a compressed subtree for reports or analysis handoffs.
limitations: Focuses on data analysis unless the user explicitly requests it for another task.
Does not run queries, calculate metrics, or validate evidence independently.
Requires user context or existing project materials to identify the core question.
Stores summaries in Markdown while detailed values and execution logs remain elsewhere.

use_cases.title: Track an investigation
use_cases.description: Maintain hypotheses, evidence, and conclusions while exploring an unexpected metric change.

use_cases.title: Review team reasoning
use_cases.description: See which branches are active, concluded, or pruned before directing the next analysis step.

use_cases.title: Prepare a research handoff
use_cases.description: Compress the relevant question subtree while preserving unresolved items and evidence boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Start an analysis tree
prompt_templates.prompt: Use analysis-tree for this data question: [question]. Create the core node, initial hypotheses, and current analysis position.

prompt_templates.title: Add new evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the analysis tree with this evidence: [evidence]. Revise affected statuses and conclusions without exceeding what the evidence supports.

prompt_templates.title: Restructure the investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current analysis tree for duplicate, misplaced, or unsupported nodes. Reorganize dependencies, prune excluded branches, and explain only major structural changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create an executive handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the latest analysis state, select the subtree relevant to [audience], preserve unresolved nodes, and produce a concise handoff with a Mermaid view.

output_examples.input: Start a tree for declining weekly conversion.
output: Core question: Why did weekly conversion decline?
Current branches: traffic mix, funnel behavior, and measurement changes.
Current position: validate whether the decline is consistent across channels.

output_examples.input: The mobile decline disappears after correcting an event definition.
output_examples.output: The measurement branch is concluded and the mobile anomaly is removed. Remaining branches retain their prior evidence and status.

output_examples.input: Prepare the current investigation for an analytics lead.
output_examples.output: The handoff includes the core question, supported conclusions, active branches, pruned reasons, and the next unresolved node.

best_practices: Provide the core data question and relevant project context before starting.
Add evidence with its scope, definition, and reliability clearly stated.
Update the same state document for the same question to preserve continuity.
anti_patterns: Do not treat tentative observations as supported conclusions.
Do not create nodes for details that do not affect a parent judgment.
Do not delete excluded hypotheses when their pruning evidence still limits the conclusion.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates and maintains a Markdown document containing the core question, conclusions, analysis tree, and current position.

faq.question: When does the skill activate?
faq.answer: It is intended for data analysis. Other tasks require an explicit request for analysis-tree or an analysis tree.

faq.question: Does it perform the data analysis?
faq.answer: No. It organizes the questions, evidence, and conclusions produced during the analysis.

faq.question: How are rejected hypotheses handled?
faq.answer: Supported exclusions remain as pruned nodes with concise evidence and a pruning reason.

faq.question: Can it visualize the tree?
faq.answer: Yes. When requested, it generates a Mermaid flowchart from the latest Markdown state.

faq.question: Can it support reports and handoffs?
faq.answer: Yes. It selects and compresses the relevant subtree while preserving unresolved nodes and evidence limits.
